subject.title: Crestodian treats installed but logged-out CLI as usable AI

question: Should this maintainer-labeled Crestodian onboarding bug be promoted to a narrow repair now, or handled with broader onboarding work?
rationale: The root cause is narrow and source-reproducible, but the protected label means automation should pause for maintainer intent before queuing repair.

options.title: Sponsor narrow repair
options.body: Make conversational setup use the existing setup-inference live-test/fallback contract and add focused regression coverage for logged-out macOS CLI candidates.

options.title: Fold into broader onboarding work
options.body: Keep this open while a maintainer fixes it together with the adjacent Codex setup-inference issue so the onboarding ladder changes land together.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow repair
recommendation.body: Make conversational setup use the existing setup-inference live-test/fallback contract and add focused regression coverage for logged-out macOS CLI candidates.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current Crestodian setup and setup-inference implementation most directly tied to this issue.
